effects: Pulls exactly `assets` USDT from the signer into the vault (Vault._deposit: safeTransferFrom(asset, caller, this, assets)).
Mints vault shares (lmMsmhUSDT) to `receiver`. The number is computed from totalAssets, totalSupply and the deposit fee rate held in storage (_previewDeposit).
A deposit fee (storage `_depositFee`, set to 0 at init, the fee manager can raise it to 35%) is taken from the assets before shares are computed.
The USDT goes into the Morpho Smokehouse USDT vault through a delegatecalled connector. The signer holds a non-transferable vault position.
formats.shown: "Deposit", with the USDT amount, the share ticker lmMsmhUSDT as a constant, and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares received is not shown; it is computed from vault state and the fee rate.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit(): (_shares, _depositFeeAmount) = _previewDeposit(assets, _newTotalAssets, totalSupply()); _mint(receiver, shares). Case 0: signer gets 1000001 lmMsmhUSDT, and the screen only shows 'Share ticker: lmMsmhUSDT'.
findings.fix: Nothing in the calldata carries the share amount. A label such as 'Shares (amount set by vault price)' would at least say so.

findings.title: deposit: intent 'Deposit' names no amount, asset or vault, and there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json deposit format: "intent": "Deposit", no interpolatedIntent. The blind reader for case 0 had to get the asset and the vault from the fields.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} into Kiln Morpho Smokehouse USDT vault for {receiver}" and an intent like 'Deposit USDT into Kiln vault'.

findings.title: deposit: 'Share ticker' is a raw constant field that adds a line but no amount.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json deposit: {"label": "Share ticker", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"}. The screen in case 0 shows 'Share ticker: lmMsmhUSDT'.
findings.fix: Fold the ticker into the receiver label ('Send lmMsmhUSDT shares to') or into the interpolated intent.

cases.notes: 1.000001 USDT out is shown exactly. 1000001 lmMsmhUSDT in: the ticker and recipient are shown but the amount is not, and the reader noted it as unknown. Deposit fee was 0, so shares equal assets.

effects: Pulls USDT from the signer. The amount is computed from the share price, rounded up, and grossed up by the deposit fee rate in storage (_previewMint). No maximum is enforced by any parameter.
The USDT is deposited into the Morpho Smokehouse USDT vault through the delegatecalled connector.
formats.shown: "Mint", with 'Deposit asset: USDT' as a constant, the number of shares minted, and the address that receives them.

findings.title: mint: the USDT amount taken from the signer is not shown and has no bound in the calldata.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol mint(): (_assets, _depositFeeAmount) = _previewMint(shares, _newTotalAssets, _newTotalSupply); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, _assets, ...). descriptor field 'Deposit asset' shows only the ticker constant USDT.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds it. Relabel to 'Pays USDT (amount set by vault price, capped by your allowance)'.

findings.title: mint: intent 'Mint' does not say that USDT is spent to get vault shares.
findings.fix: Intent 'Deposit USDT for vault shares' with interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} vault shares to {receiver}, paying USDT".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Burns vault shares from `owner`. The number is computed from assets, rounded up (_convertToShares Ceil).
If owner is not the signer, the burn spends the signer's share allowance from the owner (_spendAllowance).
Withdraws `assets` USDT from the Morpho vault through the delegatecalled connector and sends the balance delta to `receiver`.
formats.shown: "Withdraw", with an exact USDT amount, the recipient and the owner.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned from the owner is not shown; it is computed from vault state.
findings.fix: Not in the calldata. A label such as 'Burns shares from' on the owner field makes the burn explicit.

findings.title: withdraw: label 'Owner' does not say that shares are burned from this address.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json withdraw: {"path": "owner", "label": "Owner"}. Vault._withdraw: if (caller != owner) _spendAllowance(owner, caller, shares); _burn(owner, shares).
findings.fix: Label it 'Burn shares from'. Add interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver} from {owner}'s shares".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` vault shares from `owner`. If owner is not the signer, this spends the signer's allowance.
Sends USDT to `receiver`. The amount is computed from the share price, rounded down, and has no minimum-out parameter.
The USDT is pulled out of the Morpho vault through the delegatecalled connector.
formats.shown: "Redeem", with the number of shares redeemed, the recipient and the owner.

findings.title: redeem: the USDT amount received is not shown and the function has no minimum-out bound.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem(): _assets = _convertToAssets(shares, Math.Rounding.Floor, _newTotalAssets, _newTotalSupply); no min parameter. The descriptor shows no field for USDT out.
findings.fix: Not in the calldata. Name USDT in the intent ('Redeem vault shares for USDT') so the asset is at least stated.

findings.title: redeem: intent 'Redeem' does not name the USDT received, and the 'Owner' label hides the burn.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json redeem: "intent": "Redeem", no interpolatedIntent; owner field label "Owner".
findings.fix: Intent 'Redeem vault shares for USDT', interpolatedIntent "Redeem {shares} from {owner}, send USDT to {receiver}", owner label 'Burn shares from'.

couldNotCheck: The connector delegatecalled by Vault._deposit/_withdraw is not in the directory. It is resolved at runtime from the connector registry 0xde63817c82e93499357ae198518f90ac1be93a72 under name MORPHO_SMOKEHOUSE_USDT. In withdraw and redeem, the USDT sent to the receiver is the vault's balance delta after that connector runs, so I could not confirm the receiver gets exactly `assets`.
